clues: This small farming town is in South Africa. It lies in the Free State, a short ride north of Ficksburg.
Winters here are cold and summers are hot. Thin tin homes do not keep out this harsh swing.
Local farmers asked for a church close by. The town was laid out in 1911 on a farm a widow gave.
Herds of cattle are led through its streets. Wild horses roam free all through the town.
This town is the tiny home capital of its land. Its new homes are built small.
